review_notes: I read the whole file. I also grepped Mathlib for other uses of pointBot, pointsBot and presheafFiber, which turned up only the generic Point API in Sites/Point/*. The file builds the points of (C, ⊥) from shrinkYoneda and ObjectProperty.ofObj. It also builds a functor from C to points and a fiber isomorphism with evaluation. All of these reuse existing Mathlib concepts: Point, shrinkYoneda, ObjectProperty, and the evaluation functor. I found no independent competing definition of an existing concept. pointsBot is a named specialisation of ObjectProperty.ofObj, and the rubric says that is not a defect. I did not search every file in Mathlib for a duplicate of the point-of-⊥ construction, so a small uncertainty remains.
